title: A portable installer for the global skill
description: install.mjs does what install-skill.ps1 does, on any OS with Node: copy the skill into ~/.claude/skills with the real clone path baked in, and stamp which commit it came from.

clauses.text: The installed SKILL.md names this clone's kernel path instead of <kernel>, and keeps its frontmatter first.
clauses.observable_by: the installed file starts with --- and contains the clone path and no <kernel>

clauses.text: The installed copy records the git commit it was installed from.
clauses.observable_by: an installed-by comment carrying a 40-character sha

clauses.text: Re-installing replaces the previous copy rather than merging into it.
clauses.observable_by: a file left in the old install is gone afterwards

cases.description: fresh install into an empty home
an old install with a file removed upstream
